source: מדידה מחושבת מהקליפים ומנוסחאות המקור ללא שינוי
interpretationHe: הציון הגולמי שומר את מדדי הסוליה הנטועה של הכלי. מדדים אלה אינם מודל פיזיקלי ללהב נע על קרח. מדדי הלהב הנוספים אינם מחליפים ציון זה ואינם ציון תחושה.

evidence.coordinateSpace: authored reference world; in-place canonical poses plus declared reference trajectory

evidence.probeKind: declared sole probes plus skeletal joint centers (no mesh surfaces)

ballContact.reason: This action explicitly has no visible ball or declared ball contact.

evidence.alignment: horizontal root translation; raw asset poses used when provided

evidence.note: Motion is mirrored in a pelvis-centred body basis.

reasons.label: החלקת רגליים
reasons.reason: Maximum horizontal sole displacement from the first sample of each declared support window, divided by character height. Inferred support is used only when no windows were supplied.

reasons.label: מהירות גוף מול צעדים
reasons.reason: Relative difference between average root travel speed and the median backward support-foot sweep speed relative to the root. Cadence and implied stride lengths are also reported. In-place clips need an explicit reference travel scenario; stationary actions are not scored as locomotion.

reasons.label: כניסה ויציאה מול המתנה
reasons.reason: Worst entry/exit mismatch to the best matching idle phase: RMS marker error / 0.04 height, RMS bone rotation / 25 degrees, or RMS endpoint velocity error / 0.75 height per second. Horizontal root translation is aligned; root height and body pose remain measurable.
